# IPv64 – Models

<!-- Generated by Scripts/generate_docs.py – do not edit by hand. -->

Response models are `Codable, Hashable, Sendable` structs with `let` properties.
Most properties are optional because the API spec marks almost nothing as required – unwrap them.
Types conforming to `IPv64OpenEnum` are string-backed structs: compare with the listed constants,
use a `default` branch in `switch`, and create unknown values with `Type(rawValue:)`.
Input types (`…Input`) have a public memberwise `init` with `nil` defaults for optional fields.

## `AccessListEntry` (struct)

An entry of the access list of a CDN domain.

- `id: Int` – Entry ID.
- `address: String?` – IP address or network in CIDR notation, e.g. `198.51.100.0/24`.

## `AccountLink` (struct)

An account link (sharing of account management).

- `id: Int` – Link ID.
- `direction: AccountLinkDirection?` – Direction of the link.
- `email: String?` – Email of the other account.
- `status: AccountLinkStatus?` – Status of the link.
- `createdAt: Date?` – Creation time.
- `lastUsedAt: Date?` – Last use.
- `accountID: Int?` – Only for managed accounts: the ID for `X-IPv64-Act-As`.

## `AccountLinkDirection` (open enum)

Direction of an `AccountLink`.

- `.sharedWith` = `"shared_with"`
- `.managed` = `"managed"`

## `AccountLinks` (struct)

Result of `IPv64/Account/links()`.

- `sharedWith: [AccountLink]?` – Accounts that may manage your account.
- `managed: [AccountLink]?` – Accounts you may manage.

## `AccountLinkStatus` (open enum)

Status of an `AccountLink`.

- `.active` = `"active"`
- `.pending` = `"pending"`

## `AccountLogMeta` (struct)

Pagination metadata of `IPv64/Account/logs(limit:before:since:)`.

- `limit: Int?` – Limit used for this page.
- `nextBefore: Int?` – Cursor for the next page (pass as `before`); `nil` at the end.
- `retentionDays: Int?` – Retention of log entries in days.

## `APIHealth` (struct)

Result of `IPv64/Meta/health()`.

- `status: String?` – Status, e.g. `ok`.
- `version: String?` – Version, e.g. `2.0.0`.

## `APIInfo` (struct)

Result of `IPv64/Meta/info()`.

- `name: String?` – Name, e.g. `IPv64.net API`.
- `version: String?` – Version, e.g. `2.0.0`.
- `documentation: String?` – Link to the documentation.
- `time: Date?` – Server time.

## `APIKey` (struct)

An API key. The key itself is never shown again, only its start and end.

- `id: Int` – Key ID.
- `name: String?` – Name.
- `tokenHint: String?` – Start and end of the key, e.g. `1ZK4…Rx5e`.
- `createdAt: Date?` – Creation time.
- `expiresAt: Date?` – Expiry; `nil` means never.
- `expired: Bool?` – The key has expired.
- `uses: Int?` – Number of calls made with the key.

## `APIKeyCreated` (struct)

A freshly created API key, including the full key.

- `id: Int` – Key ID.
- `name: String?` – Name.
- `tokenHint: String?` – Start and end of the key.
- `createdAt: Date?` – Creation time.
- `expiresAt: Date?` – Expiry; `nil` means never.
- `expired: Bool?` – The key has expired.
- `uses: Int?` – Number of calls made with the key.
- `token: String?` – The full key. Shown only this one time.

## `FailoverPolicy` (struct)

A DNS failover policy.

- `id: String` – Policy ID (16 characters).
- `name: String?` – Name.
- `status: FailoverPolicyStatus?` – Status.
- `manual: Bool?` – The last switch was manual.
- `mode: FailoverMode?` – Switching behavior.
- `fallbackRequiresAll: Bool?` – Fallback only when all monitors are UP again.
- `linking: FailoverLinking?` – How monitors are combined.
- `notificationsEnabled: Bool?` – Notifications are enabled.
- `integrations: [Int]?` – Integrations for notifications.
- `monitorsDown: Int?` – Number of monitors currently counting as DOWN.
- `lastCheckAt: Date?` – Last check.
- `monitors: [Monitor]?` – Monitors that trigger the failover.
- `rules: [Rule]?` – Protected records and their targets.

## `FailoverPolicy.Monitor` (struct)

A healthcheck that triggers the failover.

- `healthcheck: String?` – Healthcheck token.
- `name: String?` – Name.
- `negate: Bool?` – Evaluated inverted (UP counts as DOWN).
- `healthcheckStatus: HealthcheckStatus?` – Current healthcheck status.

A protected record.

- `record: String?` – Record token of the protected record.
- `fqdn: String?` – Fully qualified name.
- `recordType: RecordType?`
- `state: FailoverRuleState?` – State of the rule.
- `target: Target?` – Replacement target.

Replacement target of a rule.

- `kind: FailoverTargetKind?` – Kind of target.
- `ip: String?` – Replacement IP.
- `record: String?` – Target record token.
- `offlinePage: String?`

## `FailoverPolicyInput` (struct)

Request body to create or update a failover policy. Only non-`nil` fields are sent.

- `name: String?` – Name.
- `mode: FailoverMode?` – Switching behavior.
- `fallbackRequiresAll: Bool?` – Fallback only when all monitors are UP again.
- `linking: FailoverLinking?` – How monitors are combined. Cannot be changed during an active failover.
- `notificationsEnabled: Bool?` – Enable notifications.
- `integrations: [Int]?` – Integrations, `0` = account e-mail.

## `HC2Check` (struct)

A healthchecks 2.0 check.

- `name: String?` – Name.
- `type: HC2CheckType?` – Check type.
- `target: String?` – Target: URL (http/keyword/json), name (dns; IP for PTR), host/IP (icmp), `host` or `host:port` (tcp/port/cert); empty for push.
- `params: HC2CheckParams?` – Type-dependent parameters.
- `intervalSeconds: Int?` – Interval in seconds, at least 20.
- `retryIntervalSeconds: Int?` – Retry interval after a failure in seconds, at least 5.
- `retries: Int?` – Additional attempts before alerting (0-10).
- `connectTimeoutSeconds: Double?` – Connection timeout in seconds.
- `timeoutSeconds: Double?` – Total timeout in seconds.
- `invert: Bool?` – Invert the result.
- `stabilize: Int?` – Measurements until a state change (1-20).
- `ipMode: HC2IPMode?` – IP mode: `auto`, `ipv4`, `ipv6` or `both`.
- `tags: [String]?` – Tags.
- `group: String?` – Group (free-form name).
- `description: String?` – Description.
- `paused: Bool?` – Paused.
- `parent: String?` – Token of the parent check (dependency) or empty.
- `critical: Bool?` – Critical: ignores quiet hours.
- `execution: HC2Execution?` – Where the check runs: `online` (ipv64), `local` (node), `both` (hybrid).
- `nodeID: String?` – Owner node for `local`/`both`; given alone it means a single measuring node.
- `nodes: [NodeReference]?` – Measuring nodes for `local`/`both`.
- `locations: [HC2Location]?` – Locations for `online`/`both`.
- `policy: HC2Policy?` – Overall rule with several measuring points.
- `notifyDegraded: Bool?` – Also notify when partially degraded.
- `notifyDown: Bool?` – Notify on failure.
- `notifyUp: Bool?` – Notify on recovery.
- `channels: [Int]?` – Channel IDs; empty = default channels.
- `repeatMinutes: Int?` – Reminder interval while the failure persists, in minutes; 0 = off.
- `token: String` – Check token (32 characters).
- `nodeName: String?` – Name of the node.
- `revision: Int?` – Revision.
- `createdAt: Date?` – Creation time.
- `updatedAt: Date?` – Time of the last change.
- `state: State?` – Current state.
- `push: Push?` – Push URLs, only for type `push`.
- `id: String` – Stable identity: the check token.

## `HC2Check.NodeReference` (struct)

A measuring node of a check.

- `nodeID: String?` – Node ID.
- `name: String?` – Node name.

- `url: String?` – Push URL at ipv64.
- `hubURL: String?` – Push URL at the hub.
- `nodePath: String?` – Path at the node (`http://<node>/api/push/<token>`).

- `lastCheckAt: Date?` – Time of the last measurement.
- `lastStatus: HC2MeasurementStatus?` – Result of the last measurement.
- `lastLatencyMS: Double?` – Latency of the last measurement in milliseconds.
- `lastReason: String?` – Reason of the last result.
- `lastMessage: String?` – Message of the last result.

Request body for creating or updating a check. When updating, only the fields provided are changed.

- `invert: Bool?` – Invert the result.
- `stabilize: Int?` – Measurements until a state change (1-20).
- `ipMode: HC2IPMode?` – IP mode: `auto`, `ipv4`, `ipv6` or `both`.

- `locations: [HC2Location]?` – Locations for `online`/`both` (count depends on the account class).

- `retryIntervalSeconds: Int?` – Active checks: interval after a failure in seconds (10 to 86400).
- `failuresBeforeAlarm: Int?` – Active checks: failures until an alarm (1 to 60).

Reporting period in UTC: `start` inclusive, `end` exclusive. At most 7 days; `end` at most 5 minutes in the future.

- `end: Date` – End of the period (exclusive).

The sensor that produced the report.

- `version: String` – Sensor software version (at most 32 characters).

## `HoneypotReport.Sensor.Mode` (open enum)

Operating mode of a sensor.

- `.custom` = `"custom"`

- `reportID: String?` – Report ID.
- `duplicate: Bool?`

## `HoneypotReportSamples` (struct)

Samples in a `HoneypotReport` (honeypot only), stored as daily totals. Every list holds at most 500 entries.

- `paths: [Counted]?` – Requested paths (at most 500).
- `userAgents: [Counted]?` – User agents (at most 500).
- `payloads: [Payload]?` – Payloads (at most 500).
- `fingerprints: [Counted]?` – Tool fingerprints (at most 500). Keys not matching `ja4:<id>` or `hassh:<md5>` are dropped.

## `HoneypotReportSamples.Counted` (struct)

A counted key (path, user agent or fingerprint).

- `count: Int` – Number of occurrences (at least 1).

A tried username/password combination.

- `count: Int` – Number of attempts (at least 1).

A payload sample.

- `head: String` – Base64 of the first bytes of the payload (at most 256 bytes).
- `service: String` – Service.
- `port: Int` – Port (0 to 65535).

## `IPv64.Configuration` (struct)

Settings of an `IPv64` client.

## `IPv64Error` (enum)

Errors thrown by `IPv64`.

- `case api(IPv64Problem)` – The server answered with an RFC 9457 problem document.
- `case httpStatus(code: Int, body: Data)` – The server answered with an error status but no readable problem document.
- `case missingAPIKey` – The endpoint requires an API key, but the client has none.
- `case invalidResponse` – The response was not an HTTP response.
- `case invalidRequest(String)` – The request URL could not be built from the given parameters.
- `case decoding(any Error, body: Data)` – The response body could not be decoded.
- `case encoding(any Error)` – A request body could not be encoded.
- `statusCode: Int?` – The HTTP status code, if the error came from the server.
- `code: String?` – The machine-readable error code such as `domain_not_found`, if available.
- `errorDescription: String?`

- `status: Int` – HTTP status code.
- `detail: String` – Human-readable error message.

- `field: String?` – Affected input field, if any.
- `retryAfter: Int?` – Seconds until the next attempt (on 429 and some 409).

- `state: CloudRouterState?` – Provisioning state; `ready` means the change was applied.
- `disabled: Bool?` – Peer is disabled.
- `siteToSite: Bool?` – Marked as site-to-site peer.
- `ipv4: String?` – Tunnel IPv4 address (CIDR).
- `ipv6: String?` – Tunnel IPv6 address (CIDR).
- `dnsServer: String?` – DNS server written into the client config.
- `endpoint: String?` – Fixed endpoint of the peer (IP or hostname).
- `endpointPort: Int?` – Port of the fixed endpoint.
- `keepalive: String?` – Keepalive as `hh:mm:ss`, e.g. `00:00:25`.
- `publicKey: String?` – Public key (Base64).
- `hasPresharedKey: Bool?` – A preshared key is set.
- `currentEndpoint: String?` – Last seen address, e.g. `198.51.100.7:51820`.
- `lastHandshake: String?` – Time of the last handshake (as sent by the server).
- `trafficBytes: TrafficBytes?` – Transferred bytes.
- `allowedIPs: [AllowedIP]?` – Additional networks in the client config.

## `Peer.AllowedIP` (struct)

An entry of the peer's AllowedIPs.

- `id: Int?` – ID, used to remove the entry.
- `network: String?` – IP or network in CIDR notation.

## `Peer.TrafficBytes` (struct)

Incoming and outgoing traffic of a peer.

- `out: Double?` – Outgoing bytes.

## `PeerInput` (struct)

Fields to change with `IPv64/Peers/update(_:_:)`. Only non-`nil` fields are sent.

- `name: String?` – Name.
- `dnsServer: String?` – DNS server for the client config; empty string means none.
- `keepalive: String?` – Keepalive as `hh:mm:ss`, e.g. `00:00:25`.
- `endpoint: String?` – Fixed endpoint (IP or hostname).
- `endpointPort: Int?` – Port of the endpoint.
- `ipv4: String?` – Tunnel IPv4 in CIDR, e.g. `10.7.0.5/32`.
- `ipv6: String?` – Tunnel IPv6 in CIDR, e.g. `fd64::5/128`.
- `disabled: Bool?` – Disable or enable the peer.
- `siteToSite: Bool?` – Mark as site-to-site peer.

## `PortForward` (struct)

A port forward of a gateway.

- `id: Int` – ID.
- `name: String?` – Name.
- `destination: String?` – Destination IP inside the tunnel.
- `targetPort: Int?` – Destination port.
- `publicPort: Int?` – Public port assigned by the server.
- `publicIP: PortForwardPublicIP?` – Which public address is used.
- `disabled: Bool?` – Disabled.
- `state: CloudRouterState?` – Provisioning state.

## `PortForwardProtocol` (open enum)

Transport protocol of a `PortForward`.

- `.tcp` = `"tcp"`
- `.udp` = `"udp"`

## `PortForwardPublicIP` (open enum)

Public address a `PortForward` listens on.

- `.server` = `"server"`
- `.router` = `"router"`

## `PublicIP` (struct)

A public IPv6 address of a `CloudRouter`.

- `id: Int` – ID.
- `ip: String?` – Address.
- `type: PublicIPFamily?` – Address family.
- `disabled: Bool?` – Disabled.
- `state: CloudRouterState?` – Provisioning state.
- `createdAt: Date?` – Creation time.

## `PublicIPAddress` (struct)

Result of `IPv64/Meta/ip()`.

- `ip: String?` – IP address, e.g. `203.0.113.10`.
- `family: IPFamily?` – Address family.

## `PublicIPFamily` (open enum)

Address family of a `PublicIP`.

- `.ipv4` = `"ipv4"`
- `.ipv6` = `"ipv6"`

## `Record` (struct)

A DNS record of a domain.

- `id: Int` – Record ID.
- `domainID: Int?` – ID of the domain the record belongs to.
- `domain: String?` – Domain, e.g. `beispiel.ipv64.de`.
- `prefix: String?` – Prefix; empty for the domain itself.
- `fqdn: String?` – Fully qualified name, e.g. `nas.beispiel.ipv64.de`.
- `type: RecordType?` – Record type.
- `content: String?` – Record content, e.g. `203.0.113.10`.
- `ttl: Int?` – TTL in seconds.
- `state: RecordState?` – Management state of the record.
- `pendingDNS: Bool?` – The change is still being propagated to the name servers.
- `token: String?` – Record token. Stays the same across IP changes and can be used instead of the ID.
- `updatedAt: Date?` – Last change.

## `RecordState` (open enum)

Management state of a `Record`.

- `.active` = `"active"`
- `.inactive` = `"inactive"`
- `.cdnRecord` = `"cdn_record"`
- `.cdnProxied` = `"cdn_proxied"`
- `.cdnPartial` = `"cdn_partial"`
- `.failoverRecord` = `"failover_record"`
- `.failoverReplaced` = `"failover_replaced"`

## `RecordType` (open enum)

DNS record type.

- `.a` = `"A"`
- `.aaaa` = `"AAAA"`
- `.cname` = `"CNAME"`
- `.mx` = `"MX"`
- `.txt` = `"TXT"`
- `.ns` = `"NS"`
- `.srv` = `"SRV"`
- `.tlsa` = `"TLSA"`
- `.caa` = `"CAA"`

## `Route` (struct)

A static route of a Cloud Router.

- `id: Int` – ID.
- `destination: String?` – Destination network (CIDR).
- `gateway: String?` – Next hop.
- `distance: Int?` – Administrative distance.
- `peer: String?` – ID of the peer behind which the network lives.
- `system: Bool?` – Created by the system; cannot be deleted.
- `disabled: Bool?` – Disabled.
- `state: CloudRouterState?` – Provisioning state.

## `StatusPage` (struct)

A public status page.

- `id: Int` – ID.
- `name: String?` – Title.
- `slug: String?` – Address behind `/status/`.
- `url: String?` – Public URL.
- `description: String?` – Description.
- `passwordProtected: Bool?` – Protected by a password.
- `design: Int?` – Design, 1 to 4.
- `autorefresh: Bool?` – The page reloads automatically.
- `healthchecks: [String]?` – Tokens of the displayed healthchecks, in display order.
- `createdAt: Date?` – Creation time.
- `lastViewedAt: Date?` – Last view.

## `StatusPageInput` (struct)

Request body to create or update a status page. Only non-`nil` fields are sent.

- `name: String?` – Title.
- `description: String?` – Description.
- `slug: String?` – Address, 3 to 128 characters a-z, A-Z, 0-9. Random if omitted on creation.
- `password: String?` – Password. An empty string makes the page public.
- `design: Int?` – Design, 1 to 4.
- `autorefresh: Bool?` – Reload the page automatically.
- `healthchecks: [String]?` – Tokens of the healthchecks to display.

## `ThreatFeed` (struct)

A page of the v64 Blocklist change feed.

- `changes: [ThreatFeedChange]?` – Changes, oldest first (at most 10 000).
- `next: String?` – Opaque cursor; pass it unchanged as `since` of the next call.
- `more: Bool?` – More changes are ready: fetch again immediately with `next`.

## `ThreatFeedChange` (struct)

A change of the v64 Blocklist.

- `ip: String?` – The IP address.
- `action: Action?` – Kind of change.
- `lists: [String]?` – Lists after the change (`v64`, `ssh`, `web`, `mail`, `rdp`, `scanner`, `research`); empty for `remove`.
- `previousLists: [String]?` – Lists before the change; empty for `add`.
- `at: Date?` – Time of the evaluation (UTC).

## `ThreatFeedChange.Action` (open enum)

Kind of change.

- `.add` = `"add"`
- `.remove` = `"remove"`
- `.update` = `"update"`

## `ThreatFeedResult` (enum)

Result of the conditional `IPv64/Threat/feed(since:ifNoneMatch:)`.

- `case changed(ThreatFeed, etag: String?)` – New data, with the ETag to send on the next call with the same cursor.
- `case notModified` – HTTP 304: nothing changed since the given ETag.

## `ThreatIP` (struct)

Information about an IP address on the v64 Blocklist.

- `ip: String?` – Normalized address.
- `family: Int?` – Address family (4 or 6).
- `listed: Bool?` – On the v64 Blocklist (releases are already deducted).
- `status: Status?` – Listing status.
- `score: Int?` – Confidence score 0 to 100 (only when listed).
- `lists: [ThreatList]?` – Sub-lists (`ssh`, `web`, `mail`, `rdp`, `scanner`, `research`).
- `kinds: [String]?` – Attack kinds, e.g. `ssh:bruteforce`.
- `ports: [Port]?` – Attacked ports reported by at least 2 accounts (at most 10).
- `firstSeen: String?` – First sighting (`yyyy-MM-dd`, UTC).
- `lastSeen: String?` – Last sighting (`yyyy-MM-dd`, UTC).
- `accounts: Int?` – Number of distinct reporting accounts.
- `country: String?` – Country (ISO 3166-1), if known.
- `asn: Int?` – Autonomous system number, if known.
- `release: Release?` – Release (delisting) state.
- `details: String?` – Page with explanation and release request.

## `ThreatIP.Port` (struct)

An attacked port.

- `service: String?` – Service, e.g. `ssh`.
- `port: Int?` – Port number.

## `ThreatIP.Release` (struct)

Release state of an IP.

- `status: Status?` – State of the release request.
- `protectedUntil: Date?` – Release is valid until (UTC); `nil` means permanent or no release.

## `ThreatIP.Release.Status` (open enum)

State of a release request.

- `.none` = `"none"`
- `.inReview` = `"in_review"`
- `.released` = `"released"`
- `.allowlisted` = `"allowlisted"`
- `.rejected` = `"rejected"`

## `ThreatIP.Status` (open enum)

Listing status of an IP.

- `.listed` = `"listed"`
- `.notListed` = `"not_listed"`
- `.released` = `"released"`
- `.allowlisted` = `"allowlisted"`

## `ThreatList` (open enum)

A v64 Blocklist sub-list.

- `.ssh` = `"ssh"`
- `.web` = `"web"`
- `.mail` = `"mail"`
- `.rdp` = `"rdp"`
- `.scanner` = `"scanner"`
- `.research` = `"research"`

## `ThreatPasswordRangeEntry` (struct)

One line of a password range response: the remaining 35 hex characters of a SHA-1 and its count.

- `suffix: String` – The remaining 35 hex characters of the SHA-1 hash (uppercase).
- `count: Int` – Number of times attackers tried the password. `0` marks a padding line.

## `ThreatStats` (struct)

Public Honeypot64 overview (cached for at most 10 minutes).

- `generatedAt: Date?` – Cache time (UTC).
- `windowDays: Int?` – Window of the rankings in days.
- `threshold: Threshold?` – Thresholds applied to rankings.
- `sensors: Sensors?` – Sensor counts.
- `attacks24h: Attacks?` – Attacks in the last 24 hours.
- `timeline: [Day]?` – Attacks per day (UTC, 30 days).
- `topPorts: [Port]?` – Most attacked ports (7 days, at most 10).
- `topKinds: [Kind]?` – Most frequent attack kinds (7 days, at most 10).
- `lists: [String: Int]?` – List sizes: `v64`, `v64_<sublist>`, `honeypot_passwords`, `honeypot_usernames`, `honeypot_bad_useragents`, `honeypot_attack_paths`.
- `top: Top?` – Top 10 per area (30 days, from `threshold.accounts` accounts).
- `info: String?` – Page with the human-readable statistics.
- `license: String?` – License of the data.

## `ThreatStats.Attacks` (struct)

Attack totals.

- `events: Int?` – Number of events.
- `sources: Int?` – Distinct attacker IPs.

## `ThreatStats.Country` (struct)

Origin country of listed IPs.

- `country: String?` – ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.
- `ips: Int?` – Listed IPs from this country.
- `events: Int?` – Events of these IPs.

## `ThreatStats.Day` (struct)

Attacks of one day.

- `day: String?` – Day (`yyyy-MM-dd`, UTC).
- `events: Int?` – Number of events.

## `ThreatStats.Kind` (struct)

An attack kind.

- `kind: String?` – Kind, e.g. `ssh:bruteforce`.
- `events: Int?` – Number of events.

## `ThreatStats.Port` (struct)

An attacked port.

- `service: String?` – Service, e.g. `ssh`.
- `port: Int?` – Port number.
- `events: Int?` – Number of events.

## `ThreatStats.Sensors` (struct)

Sensor counts.

- `active7d: Int?` – Sensors that reported in the last 7 days.
- `online: Int?` – Sensors that reported in the last 30 minutes.

## `ThreatStats.Threshold` (struct)

Thresholds applied to rankings.

- `accounts: Int?` – Minimum number of reporting accounts for rankings and lists.
- `activeAccounts7d: Int?` – Accounts whose sensors reported in the last 7 days.

## `ThreatStats.Top` (struct)

Top-10 rankings.

- `usernames: [ThreatStatsEntry]?` – Usernames.
- `passwords: [ThreatStatsEntry]?` – Passwords.
- `paths: [ThreatStatsEntry]?` – Request paths.
- `userAgents: [ThreatStatsEntry]?` – User agents.
- `fingerprints: [ThreatStatsEntry]?` – Tool fingerprints (JA4/HASSH).
- `countries: [Country]?` – Countries of origin of listed IPs.

## `ThreatStatsEntry` (struct)

A ranking entry in `ThreatStats`.

- `value: String?` – The value, e.g. a username.
- `events: Int?` – Sum of attempts (30 days).
- `accounts: Int?` – Distinct reporting accounts (30 days).

## `ThreatWatch` (struct)

Early-warning configuration: limits, networks and automatically watched DynDNS IPs.

- `limits: Limits?` – Limits of the account class.
- `networks: [ThreatWatchNetwork]?` – Registered networks.
- `dyndns: [DynDNS]?` – Automatically watched DynDNS IPs (count as verified).

## `ThreatWatch.DynDNS` (struct)

An automatically watched DynDNS IP.

- `ip: String?` – IP address.
- `domain: String?` – Domain.

## `ThreatWatch.Limits` (struct)

Limits of the early warning.

- `max: Int?` – Networks per account (Standard 3, otherwise 50).
- `minPrefixV4: Int?` – Largest allowed IPv4 network (`/16`).
- `minPrefixV6: Int?` – Largest allowed IPv6 network (`/32`).

## `ThreatWatchAlert` (struct)

An early-warning alert.

- `id: Int` – Alert ID.
- `ip: String?` – The attacking IP.
- `cidr: String?` – Network, or the IP as `/32` or `/128` for DynDNS.
- `networkID: Int?` – Network ID; `nil` for DynDNS alerts.
- `source: Source?` – Origin of the alert.
- `label: String?` – Network label, or the domain for DynDNS alerts.
- `listed: Bool?` – On the v64 Blocklist.
- `score: Int?` – Confidence score 0 to 100.
- `kinds: [String]?` – Attack kinds.
- `firstSeen: String?` – First sighting (`yyyy-MM-dd`, UTC).
- `lastSeen: String?` – Last sighting (`yyyy-MM-dd`, UTC).
- `createdAt: Date?` – Creation time.

## `ThreatWatchAlert.Source` (open enum)

Origin of an alert.

- `.network` = `"network"`
- `.dyndns` = `"dyndns"`

## `ThreatWatchAlerts` (struct)

A batch of early-warning alerts.

- `alerts: [ThreatWatchAlert]?` – Alerts, oldest first (at most 100).
- `next: String?` – Opaque cursor; pass it unchanged as `since` of the next call.

## `ThreatWatchNetwork` (struct)

A watched network.

- `id: Int` – Network ID.
- `cidr: String?` – Normalized network (without host bits), e.g. `203.0.113.0/24`.
- `label: String?` – Label.
- `verified: Bool?` – Ownership verified: every sighting alerts, otherwise only listed IPs do.
- `createdAt: Date?` – Creation time.
